test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some cats cry.

All cats dance.

**Conclusions:**

i. Even those cats who do not cry, dance.

ii. Those cats who do not cry, do not necessarily dance.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ca6bcc8bf105e5c64dabd1972e97ae0b92018bab72f12705f574a1008ef66df.png] 

Conclusions:

i. Even those cats who do not cry, dance → **F**ollow (As some cats cry and all cats dance. So as some part of the cats cry, thus the rest do not cry and whole cats comes in dance, therefore cats who do not cry, dance is true.)

ii. Those cats who do not cry, do not necessarily dance → Does not follow (As some cats cry and all cats dance. So as some part of the cats cry, thus the rest do not cry and whole cats comes in dance, therefore cats who do not cry, don't dance is false.)

∴ Here, Only i follows.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
